entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Thank you for coming, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0270_head_teacher_01

entries.text: Have you been enjoying your time here at\nNaranja Academy?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0270_head_teacher_02

entries.text: Have you been enjoying your time here at\nUva Academy?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.text: That is most wonderful to hear.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.text: I see... Do remember I am always here to lend an\near should you find yourself struggling in any way.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.text:

have simply conversed earlier in the cafeteria.\c
But let me assure you, there is a reason why I
asked you to meet me here in my office.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
